summary: Complete frontend testing of the new Global Search feature. 15 out of 16 test cases passed. All core functionality works: search trigger visible on all pages (homepage, /ressources, /calculatrice-ipp, /contact), Ctrl+K shortcut opens search, Escape key closes overlay, suggestion chips populate input, clicking results navigates correctly and closes overlay, results are grouped by category with icons. One bug found: gibberish queries show results instead of 'Aucun résultat' message.

ui_bugs.issue: Gibberish queries like 'xyzabc' or 'zzzzqqqqwwww12345' show results instead of 'Aucun résultat' message. Root cause: Category boost (+5 for Outils, +2 for Pages) is applied unconditionally in searchContent() function BEFORE the score > 0 filter, causing items with 0 actual matches to still pass the filter.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Move category boost inside the if(haystack.includes(term)) block, or apply it only if score > 0 before the final filter
